changelog.title: SteamLite 6.0.1 - Community Update
items: Replaced all standard Windows UI popups with native SteamLite modals.
Fixed an issue where adding a Non-Steam Game cover wouldn't save properly.
Fixed stacked event listeners that could cause memory leaks when opening game modals.
Improved HTTP error handling for fetching news and updates.

news.title: Community Update 6.0.1 Available
news.content: A new community update (6.0.1) is available! This update focuses heavily on bug fixes and UI consistency, replacing all remaining Windows UI popups with custom SteamLite modals. Please update to the latest version to experience the most polished version of SteamLite.

news.title: SteamLite Has Been Discontinued
news.content: As of Saturday, July 11 at 00:00, SteamLite has been officially discontinued. There will be no further updates or support. Thank you for using the application.
